claim: Same-sex marriage is legal in the American territory
label: SUPPORTS
evidence_text: Same-sex marriage is legal in the overseas territories of Akrotiri and Dhekelia , Ascension Island , Bermuda , the British Antarctic Territory , the British Indian Ocean Territory , Gibraltar and the Pitcairn Islands ; and in the Crown dependencies of Guernsey and the Isle of Man . Thus , unless Congress passes a law regarding same-sex marriage for Indian tribes , federally recognized American Indian tribes have the legal right to form their own marriage laws . American Samoa is the only unincorporated territory of the United States not to have legalized same-sex marriage . Same-sex marriage is legal in the British Antarctic Territory , which is a sector of Antarctica and is one of 14 British Overseas Territories . In the late 20th century , rites of marriage for same-sex couples without legal recognition became increasingly common .
